title: 法国拖累欧元情绪：但这次有三点不同，2012剧本重演不了？
speaker: Charlie

segments.en: Yes, I think Europe is another market that's interesting from a duration perspective
segments.zh: 是的，我认为从久期角度看，欧洲是另一个有意思的市场。

segments.en: But I would want to be very clear that this is a very tactical call on a 10-year
segments.zh: 但我想明确说，这是一个针对10年期的非常战术性的观点。

segments.en: We still cautious on longer durations beyond 10-year now going back to Europe. I think
segments.zh: 我们对10年期以上的更长久期仍持谨慎态度。回到欧洲，我认为。

segments.en: On one hand we do think that the fiscal and political situation in France will wait on the euro performance in Europe sentiment in general
segments.zh: 一方面，我们确实认为法国的财政和政治局势会拖累欧元表现和欧洲整体情绪。

segments.en: But on the other hand, I think we need to put it in perspective and I think the environment today is very different from 2012 and that that's different in in three key elements
segments.zh: 但另一方面，需要放在大背景里看，今天的环境与2012年非常不同，有三个关键差异。

segments.en: Number one grows. It's a lot more resilient now and we have German fiscal expansion to offset some of the tightenings elsewhere as this is very different from 2012 where we have basically
segments.zh: 第一，增长现在更有韧性，德国财政扩张可以抵消其他地区的紧缩，这与2012年完全不同。

segments.en: Broad-based fiscal consolidation that push grows into recessions in Europe
segments.zh: 当时广泛的财政整顿把欧洲增长推入放缓。

segments.en: The second part is that the European banking system is well capitalized
segments.zh: 第二，欧洲银行体系资本充足。

segments.en: So we cannot draw the link between a sovereign crisis directly to a banking crisis
segments.zh: 所以我们不能把主权压力直接等同于银行压力。

segments.en: And the most important part to me is that ECB has a backstop. It's not going to activate the TPI at this level in our view
segments.zh: 对我来说最重要的是，欧洲央行有后盾。我们认为在这个水平上不会启动TPI。

segments.en: But the backstop is available and and it wasn't there until very late into 2012
segments.zh: 但后盾是存在的，而2012年很晚之前都没有这个后盾。
